sections.heading: Overview
bullets: No enrage timer — this one's about not getting teleported out of position or caught by the group-wide spike.

sections.heading: Displacement
bullets: Cairn drops 3 red circles close together — after a short delay they teleport anyone standing in them to a random edge of the arena. Don't clump on them.
During Energy Surge, standing between his teleport points deals damage and knocks you back hard — stay clear of that lane.

sections.heading: Green circle spike
bullets: Spatial Manipulation needs the required number of players standing in the green circle before time runs out — missing it stacks Unseen Burden and deals heavy damage to everyone outside.

sections.heading: Targeting & hazards
bullets: Cairn targets whoever is farthest from him — keep that in mind for positioning.
Gravity Wave sends out 3 cascading waves of damage from the center — watch your spacing during it.
His defiance bar is segmented and locked for most of the fight, so CC is limited — don't expect to break it early.
